title: GitHub
author: Lumzel
description: Local-first GitHub Pull Request and Issue workbench powered by the gh CLI: inspect diffs and CI checks, review, comment, merge, draft PRs from your branch with AI, and launch Agent sessions to review PRs, fix CI, or solve issues.

en.title: GitHub
en.description: Local-first GitHub Pull Request and Issue workbench powered by the gh CLI: inspect diffs and CI checks, review, comment, merge, draft PRs from your branch with AI, and launch Agent sessions to review PRs, fix CI, or solve issues.

zh-CN.title: GitHub 工作台
zh-CN.description: 基于本机 gh CLI 的本地优先 GitHub PR 与 Issue 工作台：查看 Diff 与 CI 检查、评审评论与合并、AI 一键从当前分支生成 PR，并联动 Lumzel Agent 执行代码审查、修复 CI 或实现 Issue。

params.label: Repository Override (owner/repo)
params.description: Optional GitHub repository slug (e.g. octocat/hello-world). Leave blank to auto-detect from the current Worktree.

zh-CN.label: 指定仓库（owner/repo）
zh-CN.description: 可选覆盖目标 GitHub 仓库（如 octocat/hello-world）。留空则自动识别当前 Worktree 对应的远程仓库。

params.label: Default View
params.description: Which list opens first when launching the GitHub Deck.

zh-CN.label: 默认视图
zh-CN.description: 打开 GitHub 工作台时默认显示的标签页。

params.label: Items Per Fetch
params.description: Maximum number of PRs or Issues loaded per gh CLI query.

zh-CN.label: 单次拉取条数
zh-CN.description: 每次通过 gh CLI 查询 PR 或 Issue 列表的最大条数。

params.label: Default Merge Strategy
params.description: Pre-selected merge strategy in the PR merge confirmation dialog.

zh-CN.label: 默认合并方式
zh-CN.description: 合并 Pull Request 时默认选中的合并策略。
